summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a routine Form 6-K (the US equivalent of an LSE RNS announcement) confirming daily share repurchases under its buyback programme announced 17 February 2026. From 26 to 30 October 2026 the company bought 150,000 ordinary shares on US venues at a volume-weighted average near USD 111.7 and 50,000 on London venues near GBP 83.9, from Goldman Sachs entities; shares will be cancelled. The programme targets up to EUR 1 billion of ordinary shares in aggregate. No board recommendation or advisor opinion is stated; this is an execution update, so the watch item is pace of buyback and cancellation effect on share count.
